title: One recipe, seven deployment formats

scenes.heading: New deployer. Same recipe.
scenes.sub: Move the handoff from Helm to GitOps
voice: Your platform team is moving one cluster from a Helm workflow to Argo CD.
AICR can package the same resolved configuration for a different deployment tool.

scenes.heading: Start with the Helm output
voice: For Helm, AICR renders component values and a script that installs in dependency order.
A team using Helmfile can generate the release graph in that format instead.

scenes.heading: Render a GitOps handoff
voice: Choose Argo CD to get application manifests, or its Helm variant to package the app of apps.
Flux is another option with Helm releases and their sources.

scenes.heading: Let the deployer apply it
voice: Terraform and Rancher Fleet round out the seven formats.
For this handoff, commit the generated Argo CD artifacts to the GitOps source so Argo CD can apply them.

payoff: Keep one resolved recipe while generating deployer-specific artifacts and handing Argo CD the format it expects.
